--all.description: Include entries whose names begin with a dot

--author.description: Show each file's author in long listings

--block-size.description: Scale sizes by this block size before printing

--classify.description: Append a type indicator such as / * @ | = to each name

--color.description: Colorize output: always, auto or never

--dereference.description: Follow symbolic links and list their targets

--dereference-command-line.description: Follow symbolic links given on the command line

--dereference-command-line-symlink-to-di.description: Follow command-line symbolic links that point to directories

--directory.description: List directories themselves, not their contents

--dired.description: Emit byte offsets for Emacs dired mode

--escape.description: Print non-printable characters as C-style escapes

--file-type.description: Append a type indicator to names, except * for executables

--format.description: Choose the layout: across, commas, horizontal, long, single-column, verbose or vertical

--full-time.description: Long listing with full ISO timestamps

--hide.description: Omit entries matching this shell pattern unless -a or -A is given

--human-readable.description: Show sizes in human-readable units such as 1K or 234M

--hyperlink.description: Emit file names as terminal hyperlinks: always, auto or never

--ignore.description: Omit entries matching this shell pattern

--indicator-style.description: Choose the type indicator style: none, slash, file-type or classify

--no-group.description: Omit the group column in long listings

--numeric-uid-gid.description: Show numeric user and group ids in long listings

--quote-name.description: Enclose entry names in double quotes

--quoting-style.description: Choose how names are quoted: literal, locale, shell, shell-always, shell-escape, shell-escape-always, c or escape

--si.description: Show sizes in human-readable units using powers of 1000

--size.description: Show the allocated size of each file in blocks

--sort.description: Sort by: none, size, time, version, extension, name or width

--tabsize.description: Assume this tab width instead of 8

--time.description: Choose which timestamp to show and sort by: atime, ctime or birth

--time-style.description: Choose the timestamp format: full-iso, long-iso, iso, locale or a + format

--width.description: Assume this screen width instead of the terminal size

--zero.description: End each output line with NUL instead of newline

-C.description: Arrange entries in columns, sorted down

-D.description: Emit byte offsets for Emacs dired mode

-F.description: Append a type indicator such as / * @ | = to each name

-G.description: Omit the group column in long listings

-H.description: Follow symbolic links given on the command line

-I.description: Omit entries matching this shell pattern

-L.description: Follow symbolic links and list their targets

-Q.description: Enclose entry names in double quotes

-T.description: Assume this tab width instead of 8

-U.description: List entries in directory order without sorting

-a.description: Include entries whose names begin with a dot

-b.description: Print non-printable characters as C-style escapes

-c.description: Use the status change time for sorting and display

-d.description: List directories themselves, not their contents

-f.description: List all entries in directory order without sorting

-g.description: Long listing without the owner column

-h.description: Show sizes in human-readable units such as 1K or 234M

-m.description: Stream entries across the page, separated by commas

-n.description: Show numeric user and group ids in long listings

-o.description: Long listing without the group column

-p.description: Append a slash to directory names

-s.description: Show the allocated size of each file in blocks

-t.description: Sort by modification time, newest first

-u.description: Use the last access time for sorting and display

-v.description: Sort by version numbers embedded in names

-w.description: Assume this screen width instead of the terminal size

-x.description: Arrange entries in columns, sorted across
